findings.governingReading: In a Japanese building, the drop would unquestionably correspond to roughly the eighth floor.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the Japanese-building scale comparison with a normal house.

findings.evidenceJa: 足の骨に罅でも入って
findings.governingReading: On asphalt, he might at least have cracked a leg bone.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the injury and escalates a possible crack into definitely broken legs.

findings.highlight: for the whole three hours to the forest’s edge
findings.evidenceJa: 森の出口まで最短の三時間
findings.governingReading: Even by the shortest route, reaching the forest exit takes three hours.
findings.explanation: The English presents three hours as a fixed duration and omits that it is the minimum possible time.

findings.evidenceJa: すぐそこまで追ってくる
findings.governingReading: The darkness is pursuing them and has already drawn immediately near.
findings.explanation: The English says it is overtaking them, changing proximity into relative motion.

findings.highlight: a black wall bearing down to engulf us
findings.evidenceJa: 真っ黒い壁が少しずつ速度をあげ
findings.governingReading: The imagined pitch-black wall gradually gathers speed as it drives forward to swallow them.
findings.explanation: The English omits the gradual acceleration that creates the tactical danger.

findings.highlight: The enemy’s speed and ours are about the same.
findings.evidenceJa: 壁の速度と俺の速度はほぼ同じ
findings.governingReading: The wall’s speed is nearly equal to Shirou’s own speed.
findings.explanation: The English changes a comparison with Shirou individually into one with the group, despite Illya already forcing him to slow.

findings.highlight: my torso crushed by strength like a machine, all while I’m still conscious
findings.evidenceJa: まだ意識がのこったままの上半身を工事現場の機械みたいにズバーングシャーンと木っ端微塵、跡形も無く踏み潰され
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines his still-conscious upper half being stamped utterly out of existence like construction machinery, with explosive comic sound effects.
findings.explanation: The English reduces a specific, grotesquely comic annihilation image to a torso crushed by machine-like strength.

findings.evidenceJa: ここまで戻って来たかと思うと
findings.governingReading: Kotomine has doubled back and returned as far as Shirou and Illya.
findings.explanation: The English changes a tactical return into merely walking over.

findings.highlight: picks Illya up, and starts running
findings.evidenceJa: 有無を言わさず、イリヤを抱えて走り出した
findings.governingReading: Without allowing either of them any say, Kotomine takes Illya and runs.
findings.explanation: The English omits Kotomine’s decisive refusal to permit objection.

findings.highlight: talking about this with such disinterest
findings.evidenceJa: 今の立場なら幸運と喜ぶべき事をつまらなげに語る
findings.governingReading: Kotomine speaks dully about something their present position should make him welcome as good fortune.
findings.explanation: The English retains disinterest but omits why it is striking: he should be pleased by this fortunate circumstance.

findings.highlight: The course of the attacks is too easy to read for an assassin.
findings.evidenceJa: 山の主を名乗るにしては、読み易い太刀筋だ
findings.governingReading: Kotomine says that for one who calls himself lord of the mountain, Assassin’s attack lines are too readable.
findings.explanation: The English removes the title and recasts the comparison as a generic standard for an assassin.

findings.highlight: The priest easily knocked them all aside
findings.governingReading: The priest cuts all three projectiles down without effort.
findings.explanation: The English changes cutting them down into knocking them aside.
